verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting and compute platform, so automatic placement of functions near backend data is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents serverless functions and a global CDN, but nothing about automatically placing compute near data sources. The Turso integration is a third-party edge database that moves data toward edge functions, not compute toward data, so it is an adjacent integration and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on automatic compute placement near backend data to optimize latency
